title: Texas Standard for Oct. 29, 2026: Remembering labor and civil rights leader Dolores Huerta
summary: Dolores Huerta, the labor organizer who co-founded the United Farm Workers and helped popularize the rallying cry “Sí, se puede,” has died at 96. Her activism stretched from farmworker rights...
content: Dolores Huerta, the labor organizer who co-founded the United Farm Workers and helped popularize the rallying cry “Sí, se puede,” has died at 96. Her activism stretched from farmworker rights to race, poverty, LGBTQ+ issues and women’s rights, with an impact felt well beyond California. Source
